articles.title: 55,000 extra social housing homes are being built. But a new study shows that boom still falls short
articles.summary: Australia plans to deliver an extra 55,000 quality homes for low-income citizens by 2030, thanks to unprecedented public funding in the 2020s. This national initiative aims to nearly triple the existing social housing stock, significantly boosting affordable housing availability and improving living conditions for vulnerable populations across the nation.

articles.title: India Greenlights Acquisition of 114 Rafales
articles.summary: India's Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) on Feb. 12, 2026, accorded Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) for acquiring additional Dassault Rafale fighters. This crucial approval, part of the Multi-Role Fighter Aircraft (MRFA) program, significantly bolsters India's air power and strategic defence capabilities. Such acquisitions are vital for enhancing national security and maintaining a robust deterrent posture against evolving regional threats.

articles.title: Tie up Processes under National Aero Engine Mission launched
articles.summary: India has initiated a major fighter jet engine development project with France, operating under a new National Aero Engine Mission. This strategic collaboration highlights India's strong commitment to achieving self-reliance in advanced defence technology. The partnership aims to reduce dependence on foreign suppliers for critical military hardware, significantly boosting indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities and enhancing national security.

articles.title: Fantasy Basketball Week 18 Start/Sit: Why Fantasy managers may want to prioritize Tristan Vukcevic
articles.summary: The All-Star weekend concluded, offering players essential rest before entering the demanding final two months of the regular season. This period is crucial as teams' directions become clearer, strategizing for playoff pushes or potential rebuilding. The upcoming phase will focus on intense competition and performance adjustments as the season progresses towards its climax.

articles.title: Infra accelerates in NE states close to China border
articles.summary: India is undertaking a massive infrastructure development drive along its northern borders with China. This strategic push involves projects like underwater tunnels and highway-based emergency landing facilities, significantly enhancing connectivity and bolstering defence preparedness in critical border areas. Such initiatives are vital for national security and rapid deployment, improving India's strategic posture.

articles.title: Khelo India Winter Games starting from Feb 23, raises hopes of tourism revival in Gulmarg
articles.summary: The Khelo India Winter Games are set to commence on February 23 in Gulmarg, Kashmir, attracting over 700 athletes and officials. This national sporting event promotes winter sports and youth participation across India. Its successful organisation in a region like Kashmir underscores the government's focus on mainstreaming the area through sports, fostering national integration, and boosting regional development and tourism, aligning with national building objectives.

articles.title: French defence major Thales sets up R&D centre in Bengaluru
articles.summary: French defence major Thales is setting up an R&D centre in India to drive advanced research, bolstering the nation's self-reliance vision. This move highlights India's push for indigenous defence technology and manufacturing. For SSB aspirants, it signifies strengthened strategic autonomy, fostered innovation, and international collaboration in critical sectors, aligning with the 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' initiative.

articles.title: The YouTuber Who Paid His Own Way Into Hollywood
articles.summary: Recent box office data revealed a significant trend where four out of the top five grossing movies were independent productions, not from major studios. This highlights the growing success of smaller films, exemplified by 'Solo Mio,' an inspirational romantic drama starring Kevin James, challenging traditional studio dominance and signalling a shift in audience preferences within the entertainment industry.
